eq_prefix_amplifier.name: R5_E8_SELECTOR_PREFIX_AMPLIFICATION_LEMMA_V1
eq_prefix_amplifier.formula: EQ_k = AND_i ((x_i OR NOT y_i) AND (NOT x_i OR y_i))
precondition: t distinct selector variables x_i are projected
none of their corresponding y_i tags is projected before those t selector steps
frozen structural executor only; no semantic merging
proof_obligations_closed: Repeated Project creates a binary OR-of-cofactor tree over the 2^t selector assignments.
Each branch contains a distinct y-tag minterm together with untouched equivalence constraints.
Distinct tag assignments define distinct branch functions.
For k>=2 the branch roots are nonconstant and pairwise non-complementary.
Structural interning can merge only identical structural refs; the frozen complement rule can collapse only exact complements.
Therefore at least 2^t distinct branch-root refs remain reachable.

shared_payload_amplifier.name: R5_E8_SHARED_PAYLOAD_SELECTOR_AMPLIFIER_V1
shared_payload_amplifier.formula: F_k = AND_i ((x_i OR A_i(Z)) AND (NOT x_i OR B_i(Z)))

selector_semantics.x_i=0: A_i survives; the opposite selector clause is satisfied
selector_semantics.x_i=1: B_i survives; the opposite selector clause is satisfied

required_branch_separation.BRANCH_ROOT_INJECTIVITY: for distinct selector assignments a!=b, frozen branch-root refs differ
required_branch_separation.NONCONSTANT: every counted branch root is nonconstant
required_branch_separation.NONCOMPLEMENT: no counted branch-root pair is an exact complemented ref
required_branch_separation.PERSISTENCE: all counted roots remain reachable through the repeated Shannon OR tree

shared_payload_amplifier.consequence_if_branch_separation_proved: t selector projections before payload cleanup imply at least 2^t live branch roots

scheduler_obligations.S1: Frozen exact greedy selects selector variables for t(k) relevant steps before payload cleanup destroys the branch separation invariant.
scheduler_obligations.S2: t(k) >= alpha*k for one fixed alpha>0 and all sufficiently large k.
scheduler_obligations.S3: The proof compares every competing unresolved semantic variable under the exact frozen cost/tie rule.
scheduler_obligations.S4: No SAT oracle, semantic equivalence oracle, FRAIG, BDD sweeping, or hidden existential escape.

assumptions: |F_k| <= k^c * polylog(k) for one fixed c
asymptotic_falsification.conclusion: PEAK(F_k) >= 2^(alpha*k), which is superpolynomial in the encoded input length
